</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1009.0" y="617" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#f3f5f7" stroke="#263348" />

<tspan x="1032.0" dy="0">Activation</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="454.0" y="647" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#c9f1cd" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="477.0" y="660" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="477.0" dy="0">Prob. / Sample</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="639.0" y="647" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#ffddb3" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="662.0" y="660" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="662.0" dy="0">Recurrent</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="629.0" y="688" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="629.0" dy="0">T: padded time axis; B: batch; V: realized vocabulary; E=128; H=256</tspan>
<tspan x="629.0" dy="16.52">lengths enter packing through a side port; recurrent weights are reused across time</tspan>
<tspan x="629.0" dy="16.52">nn.GRU is a library boundary; model returns logits; caller Sigmoid / threshold are outside</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="629.0" y="762" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="629.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="629.0" y="792" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="629.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="629.0" y="817" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="629.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
